steps.text: A current-carrying wire produces circular field lines (right-hand grip rule).
Force on a conductor: F = BIL sinθ, perpendicular to both B and I.
Force on a moving charge: F = Bqv sinθ, perpendicular to both B and v.
The force is always perpendicular to velocity, so a charge in a uniform field moves in a circle.
Fleming's left-hand rule gives the direction of the force.
Magnetic flux Φ = BA cosθ; changing flux induces an EMF (Faraday's law).
